THIS DAY, THE COURT MADE THE FOLLOWING:
 ORDER
The captioned petition is filed by the owner of the land bearing Sy.No.169/1.
The grievance of the petitioner before this Court is that petitioner is the owner of the land bearing Sy.No.169 totally measuring 9 acres 7 guntas.

sentences.text: The petitioner admits that the respondent/State has acquired 7 acres 1 gunta out of total extent measuring 9 acres 7 guntas.
The petitioner claims that he has retained 2 acres 5 guntas post acquisition.
2. The petitioner applied for phodi for having lost 7 acres 1 gunta on account of acquisition by the respondent/State.
The authority while effecting phodi have found that the petitioner is in possession of lesser extent than what is indicated in the revenue records vide Annexure-A.

Therefore, petitioner feeling aggrieved by the utilization of excess land than what was acquired is before this Court seeking a direction against the respondents to pay compensation to the land utilized in excess of the extent indicated in acquisition proceedings.
3. Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned HCGP for the respondent/State.
Perused the records.
4. Sy.No.169 totally measures 9 acres 7 guntas.
The petitioner's land is acquired under three separate NC: 2023:KHC-D:10334 notifications.
The respondent Nos.1 to 7 under two separate notifications have acquired 3 acres 17 guntas and 3 acres 9 guntas whereas PWD has acquired 16 guntas for the purpose of formation of road.
However, on survey, the petitioner is informed by the concerned survey authorities that petitioner's extent retained post acquisition is less than 2 acres 5 guntas.

It would be useful for this Court to cull out the endorsement issued by the Taluka Surveyor,
Mudhol, vide Annexure-G which reads as under:

If respondent Nos.1 Shri Sangappa S/O Satyappa Gaddi vs The Managing Director on 11 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/119357979/
3 to 7 have utilized in excess of land acquired, then petitioner being a lawful owner deserves to be compensated.

sentences.text: Respondent Nos.1 to 7 if are found to have utilized larger extent than what was acquired, then they are bound to pay compensation under the New Act.
Therefore, I am of the view that necessary direction needs to be issued to respondent Nos.1 to 7.

The petitioner has valuable rights in the immovable property and respondents being officials of State cannot utilize the private property without having recourse to the provisions of the Land Acquisition Act.
Therefore, this is a NC: 2023:KHC-D:10334 fit case where mandamus needs to be issued to the respondents.

6. For the reasons stated supra, I pass the following:
ORDER (i) The writ petition stands disposed of;
(ii) The respondent Nos.1 to 7 are hereby directed to hold an enquiry by getting the petitioner's land measured afresh after notifying the petitioner;
(iii) In the event, respondent Nos.1 to 7 are found to have utilized any excess land than what was acquired under two notifications, respondent Nos.5 and 7 are under bounden duty to issue a fresh notification and pass an award in respect of excess portion that is utilized by respondent Nos.1 to 7;
(iv) This action shall be completed by respondent Nos.1 to 7 within a period of four months from the date of receipt of a copy of this order.
